class.name: TransitionManager
class.brief_description: Schedules musically timed transitions based on measures or cue markers.
class.description: The TransitionManager listens to an [AudioClock] and waits for a specific musical condition before emitting [signal transition_triggered]. It supports queued transitions at measure boundaries, queued transitions at named cue markers, and immediate trigger requests that bypass waiting. This separates the decision to transition from the actual playback logic that performs the jump or crossfade.

method.name: cancel_switch
method.description: Cancels any currently queued transition request.

method.name: is_transition_queued
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a measure-based or marker-based transition request is currently pending.

method.name: queue_switch_at_marker
method.description: Queues a transition that will trigger when the connected [AudioClock] emits the specified cue marker.

method.name: queue_switch_at_measure
method.description: Queues a transition that will trigger when the connected [AudioClock] reaches the specified 1-based measure number.

method.name: trigger_transition_immediate
method.description: Triggers [signal transition_triggered] immediately without waiting for a future measure or marker.

members.member: Path to the [AudioClock] node monitored by this manager.

signal.name: transition_triggered
signal.description: Emitted when the queued transition condition is met or when an immediate transition is requested. For measure-based triggers, [param measure_number] contains the triggering measure and [param marker_name] is empty. For marker-based triggers, [param marker_name] contains the cue name and [param measure_number] is typically set to [code]-1[/code] or another sentinel depending on the trigger path.
